billableSizeInGBs.description: Total storage size in GBs that will be charged.

compartmentId.description: The OCID of the compartment in which the container repository exists.

createdBy.description: The id of the user or principal that created the resource.

additionalProperties.description: The value of the tag. Only the String type is supported.

Key-value pair representing a defined tag key and value, scoped to a namespace.

Example: `{"CostCenter": "42"}`

definedTags.description:
Defined tags for this resource. Each key is predefined and scoped to a
namespace. For more information, see [Resource Tags](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/resourcetags.htm).

Example: `{"Operations": {"CostCenter": "42"}}`

freeformTags.description:
Free-form tags for this resource. Each tag is a simple key-value pair with no
predefined name, type, or namespace. For more information, see [Resource Tags](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/resourcetags.htm).

Example: `{"Department": "Finance"}`

id.description:
The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the container repository.

Example: `ocid1.containerrepo.oc1..exampleuniqueID`

isImmutable.description: Whether the repository is immutable. Images cannot be overwritten in an immutable repository.

isPublic.description: Whether the repository is public. A public repository allows unauthenticated access.

layersSizeInBytes.description: Total storage in bytes consumed by layers.

lifecycleState.description: The current state of the container repository.

namespace.description: The tenancy namespace used in the container repository path.

additionalProperties.description:
Key-value pair representing a system tag key and value, scoped to a namespace.
Example: `{"free-tier-retained" : "true"}`

systemTags.description:
The system tags for this resource. Each key is predefined and scoped to a namespace.
Example: `{"orcl-cloud": {"free-tier-retained": "true"}}`

timeCreated.description: An RFC 3339 timestamp indicating when the repository was created.

timeLastPushed.description: An RFC 3339 timestamp indicating when an image was last pushed to the repository.

content.description: Readme content. Avoid entering confidential information.

format.description: Readme format. Supported formats are text/plain and text/markdown.
